metadata.tagline: Create AlayaCare client from MAC PDF
metadata.agentDescription: Upload MAC PDF to create client in AlayaCare UAT.

agent.name: Create AlayaCare Client from MAC PDF v3
agent.agentDescription: Upload a MAC referral PDF to extract client details and create a client in AlayaCare UAT.

tools.name: alayacare_create_client
tools.toolDescription: Creates a new client in AlayaCare UAT. Returns integer id of the new client.
tools.purpose: Create AlayaCare client with basic demographics and MAC ID
tools.schemaDefinition: {"type":"object","properties":{"first_name":{"type":"string","description":"Client first name"},"last_name":{"type":"string","description":"Client last name"},"gender":{"type":"string","description":"Gender code: M F or O"},"external_id":{"type":"string","description":"MAC Aged Care ID e.g. AC27413301"},"language":{"type":"string","description":"ISO 639-1 code e.g. en"},"timezone":{"type":"string","description":"IANA timezone e.g. Australia/Adelaide"},"correspondence_method":{"type":"string","description":"Preferred contact method: mail or email"}},"required":["first_name"]}

parametersDefinition.name: gender
parametersDefinition.parameterDescription: Gender code M F or O

parametersDefinition.name: external_id
parametersDefinition.parameterDescription: MAC Aged Care ID e.g. AC27413301

parametersDefinition.name: correspondence_method
parametersDefinition.parameterDescription: Preferred contact method mail or email

tools.name: alayacare_update_client_demographics
tools.toolDescription: Updates demographics for an AlayaCare client. Use integer id from alayacare_create_client as client_id.
tools.purpose: Update AlayaCare client DOB phone email address Medicare care needs
tools.schemaDefinition: {"type":"object","properties":{"client_id":{"type":"string","description":"Integer client ID from alayacare_create_client response"},"birthday":{"type":"string","description":"Date of birth YYYY-MM-DD"},"phone_personal":{"type":"string","description":"Mobile phone number"},"email":{"type":"string","description":"Email address"},"address":{"type":"string","description":"Street address"},"city":{"type":"string","description":"City or suburb"},"state":{"type":"string","description":"State code e.g. SA"},"zip":{"type":"string","description":"Postcode"},"health_card":{"type":"string","description":"Medicare number"},"care_needs":{"type":"string","description":"Brief care needs summary"}},"required":["client_id","birthday"]}

parametersDefinition.name: client_id
parametersDefinition.parameterDescription: Integer client ID from create client response

tools.name: alayacare_create_self_contact
tools.toolDescription: Creates a self-contact for the client. Use integer id from alayacare_create_client as client_id.
tools.schemaDefinition: {"type":"object","properties":{"client_id":{"type":"integer","description":"Integer client ID no quotes"},"first_name":{"type":"string","description":"Client first name"},"last_name":{"type":"string","description":"Client last name"},"phone_personal":{"type":"string","description":"Mobile phone number"},"email":{"type":"string","description":"Email address"},"address":{"type":"string","description":"Street address"},"city":{"type":"string","description":"City or suburb"},"state":{"type":"string","description":"State code e.g. SA"},"zip":{"type":"string","description":"Postcode"}},"required":["client_id","first_name"]}

systemPromptDefinition.name: MAC PDF Extraction
systemPromptDefinition.promptMessage: Extract structured client data from a My Aged Care (MAC) referral PDF. Return ONLY valid JSON with these exact fields: first_name, last_name, gender (M/F/O), birthday (YYYY-MM-DD), external_id (MAC Aged Care ID e.g. AC27413301), language (en), timezone (Australia/Adelaide for SA), correspondence_method (mail for Post / email), phone_personal (mobile or null), phone_main (home or null), email (or null), address (street only), city, state, zip, country (AU), health_card (Medicare number), care_needs (2-3 sentence summary of recommended services from the assessment). Rules: Male=M Female=F. DOB DD/MM/YYYY convert to YYYY-MM-DD. Not applicable=null.

systemPromptDefinition.name: AlayaCare API Orchestration
systemPromptDefinition.promptMessage: You are an AlayaCare intake assistant. Call the three tools IN ORDER: 1) alayacare_create_client - use the extracted data. 2) alayacare_update_client_demographics - use the integer id from tool 1 response as client_id. 3) alayacare_create_self_contact - use the integer id from tool 1 response as client_id. After success report: AlayaCare Client ID created: [id], MAC ID: [external_id], Link: https://asa.uat.alayacare.com/patients/clients/[id]/details
